by Danielle Cochran

October 14, 2026

If you’re tired of thinking about what to make for dinner every night, my weekly meal plans to take the stress out of dinnertime! I’m here to do the thinking for you when it comes to cook this week. Save the recipes you want to make, head to the grocery store, and you can skip the frozen pizza and expensive delivery services!

This Meal Plan Includes

Meal Prep & Ingredient Swaps

Korean BBQ Chicken Bowl: For meal prep, make the chicken, rice, sweet potatoes, and sauce ahead, then assemble your bowls when you’re ready to eat.

Crispy Cheesy Beef Tacos: You can make the beef filling and avocado cilantro sauce ahead of time, then assemble and cook the tacos when ready to serve for the best crispy texture.

One Pot Easy Chicken Stew: Roasting your own chicken adds incredible flavor, but using a rotisserie chicken works beautifully and saves time.

Spaghetti and Meatballs: Use an ice cream/cookie scoop to make evenly sized meatballs. This helps them cook at the same rate.

Cornflake Chicken Tenders: Ensure the oil is adequately heated before frying the tenders, and don’t overcrowd the skillet. Cook each side for the specified time to achieve that crispy golden exterior.

Pumpkin Cinnamon Rolls: Pumpkin adds quite a bit of moisture to yeast dough, so make sure to level the measuring cup. Too much pumpkin can make the dough sticky and difficult to work with.
